oracle-cue/M1.settings: Manual, HOT CUE, limit 4, 1.1Bars on, repeat off

oracle-cue/M2.settings: Manual, HOT CUE, limit 8, 1.1Bars on, repeat every 8 bars

oracle-cue/M3.settings: Manual, MEMORY CUE, limit 10, 1.1Bars on, repeat every 16 bars

oracle-cue/M4.settings: Manual, HOT CUE, limit 4, 1.1Bars off, repeat every 4 bars

oracle-cue/M5a.settings: M2 on the seeded library, overwrite off

oracle-cue/M5b.settings: M2 on the seeded library, overwrite on

oracle-cue/M5c.settings: M3 on the seeded library, overwrite off

oracle-cue/M5d.settings: M3 on the seeded library, overwrite on

columns: Kind, InMsec, InFrame, OutMsec, Comment, Color, ColorTableIndex, ActiveLoop, BeatLoopSize, CueMicrosec, InMpegFrame, InMpegAbs
grid: rekordbox's grid of each run (oracle-a Normal mode); our own Normal-mode grids equal oracle-a's (analysis scorecards)
pending: the statement order of the cue writes (no SQL trace: the instrumented copy exits at startup now)
